description: Rank-1 recipe e2000fs_calib_offset_roll (team functions design / spectral_objective / prior_split / native_head / estimate_state / apply_state copied unchanged): DirMO-24 feat30 (21 constant + 24 x 9 lead-varying inputs per 24-lead block, team column order), three multi_output_tree XGBoost 2.1.4 blocks (depth 3, lr 0.03, 900 rounds, PARAMS seed 42 only), spectral loss (weight on observed speed >= 550 km/s + 0.1 pseudo-Huber FFT term), training y forward-filled along target time (team rule), a prior model fit on the training rows with origin + 144 h <= (last training origin - 3 months) that predicts the last training quarter, and a frozen per-lead offset 0.25 x mean residual of that prior over the last 336 calibration rows added to the query forecast, clip 1-3000. What differs from rank 1: the inputs are the team raw-only df with the DirMO lab gap fill (causal last value; solar-wind observations without limit, image columns at most 24 h with img_age_h grown, ENLIL not filled; rank 1 fills every column without limit), as in our DS entry, and two regime dials are chosen per period: the tail weight t in {2, 4, 6} (weight t instead of 4 on y >= 550 km/s, prior and full model) and a recurrence pull w in {0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3} on leads 25-72 (forecast + w x (rec27 input at that lead - forecast) after the offset; no pull where rec27 is missing; clip 1-3000). (t, w) minimises the board metric S over all 72 leads of the prior model's forecast + its own offset + pull on the calibration quarter's 00/06/12/18 UTC origins against the raw training speed (missing hours left out); ties go to the smaller t, then the smaller w; the full model is then trained with t and the query forecast gets that t's offset and the pull w. Selection of (t, w) uses only pre-cutoff training data (the prior model's calibration quarter); no other row and no query truth is read. Pre-registered in jsy301 DirMO lab plans/post_freeze/01_night_run.md (round RC). Submitted because its team-board dry-run Total S was below 101 (user rule 2026-11-08); lab gate result: fail (round RC seed 42: pooled W0-W3 -0.98 % with CI99 spanning 0, placebo contrasts not significant, TIMSE part +0.66 %, one window 80 % of the gain; closed in the lab). No other board number chose anything in this entry; the arm and its rule were fixed before any dry-run.

data.gap_fill: inputs causal last value along the hourly origin timeline (observations unlimited, images <= 24 h with img_age_h grown by the hours carried, ENLIL none) - the DirMO lab fill as in our DS entry; the team fills every column without limit
data.time_convention: newest input of origin O is the hour labelled O-1h; lead h target is hour O+h
data.training_rows: df fit_F1/fit_F2/fit_F3 (origin + 144 h <= cutoff), hourly origins; origins whose filled targets still have a gap (start of the record) are left out
data.training_y: targets of the fit rows forward-filled along target time (last observed hourly speed, only the fit rows' own targets; team rule); query rows are read without y

hyperparameters.base_score: block mean of the filled training targets (team native_head)

dials.pull: leads 25-72: pred + w (rec27 - pred) after the offset, rec27 = the df's lead-varying rec27 input of the same origin after the fill, NaN -> no pull; then clip 1-3000
dials.selection: (t*, w*) = argmin over the grid of S (official per-lead formula: mean over leads 1-72 of sqrt(RMSE_h sqrt(TIMSE_h)), 100 linear percentile intervals) of apply_state(prior_t, offset_t) then the pull w on leads 25-72, on the calibration rows with origin hour in {0, 6, 12, 18} UTC, truth = the raw (unfilled) training y of those rows, NaN cells excluded; ties -> smaller t, then smaller w. The full model is trained with t*, the query forecast gets offset_{t*} and pull w*. Only pre-cutoff training rows are read; no placebo or control arm is part of the entry

hyperparameters.loss: team spectral_objective: weight t on y >= 550 else 1 (normalised to mean 1 per lead), + 0.1 x pseudo-Huber (scale 50) term on the FFT of the 24-lead error; hessian weights + 0.1; t = 4 is the team function
hyperparameters.offset: team estimate_state: 0.25 x mean(filled y - prior) over the last 336 calibration rows per lead; team apply_state: forecast + offset, clip 1-3000
hyperparameters.prior_model: same recipe on reference rows origin + 144 h <= boundary (boundary = last training origin - 3 months), predicting the calibration rows (origins >= boundary)
hyperparameters.strategy: rank-1 e2000fs_calib_offset_roll: DirMO-24 feat30, 3 blocks of 24 leads, multi_output_tree
